title: N -W F P Forest Amendment Act 1996

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Forest Amendment Act 1996
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT II OF 1996
FOREST (NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE)
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1996.
ACT II OF 1996
An
Act further to amend the Forest Act, 1927
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 7th July, 1996]
No.PA/N.W.F.P./Legis/96/ 11563,
dated 7-7-1996.---The Forest (North-West Frontier Province) (Amendment) Bill,
1996, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the North-West Frontier
Province on the 23rd June, 1996, and assented to by the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province on the 3rd July, 1996, is hereby published as test
Act of the. Provincial Legislature of North West Frontier Province.
1. Short title and commencement.--This Act may be called the Forest
(North-West Frontier Province) (Amendment) Act, 1996.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 26 of Act XVI of 1927

ACT II OF 1996

(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1996.
ACT II OF 1996
An
Act further to amend the Forest Act, 1927
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 7th July, 1996]
No.PA/N.W.F.P./Legis/96/ 11563,
dated 7-7-1996.---The Forest (North-West Frontier Province) (Amendment) Bill,
1996, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the North-West Frontier
Province on the 23rd June, 1996, and assented to by the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province on the 3rd July, 1996, is hereby published as test
Act of the. Provincial Legislature of North West Frontier Province.
2. Amendment of section 26 of Act XVI of 1927.---In the Forest Act,
1927, hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in section 26, in subsection
(1), for the expression "shall be punishable with imprisonment for a term
which may extend to six months, or with fine which may extend to five hundred
rupees, or with both, in addition to such compensation for damage done to the
forest as the convicting Court may direct to be paid", occurring at the
end, the following shall be substituted, namely: ,
"shall be punishable with
imprisonment for a term which may extend to two years, or with fine which may
extend to ten thousand rupees, or with both, in addition to such compensation
for damage done to the forest as the convicting Court may direct to be paid;
Provided that where the value of
the forest produce, as assessed by the forest officer, exceeds ten thousand
rupees, the offence shall be punishable with imprisonment which shall not be less
than three months and with fine which shall not be less than five thousand
rupees, in addition to such compensation for the damage done to the forest as
the convicting Court may direct, which shall not be less than twice the value
of the damage so done. ".

4. Amendment of section 42 of Act XVI of 1927.---In the said Act,
in section 42, for subsection (1), the following shall be substituted, namely:
"(1) The Provincial
Government may by such rules prescribe as penalties for the contravention
thereof -imprisonment for a term which may extend to two years, or fine which
may extend to ten thousand rupees, or both:
Provided that where the value of
the forest produce, as assessed by the forest officer, exceeds ten thousand
rupees, the offence shall be punishable with imprisonment which shall not be
less than three months and with fine which shall not be less than five thousand
rupees, in addition to such compensation for the damage done to the forest as
the convicting Court may direct, which shall not be less than twice the value
of the damage so done.".

punishable with imprisonment which shall not be
less than three months and with fine which shall not be less than five thousand
rupees, in addition to such compensation for the damage done to the forest as

of the damage so done.
